projects.title: SDL3-based C++ Audio Visualizer
projects.desc: A DSP project that utilizes concepts of FFT and encodes media through FFMPEG in C/C++ which allows for the synthesis of audio reactive videos.

projects.title: GWeb Dodge
projects.desc: A HaxeFlixel music-based game made in 5 days about dodging falling bricks and shooting evil triangles.

projects.title: FNF Vs Tabi
projects.desc: An indie project with a team of 4 members creating a modification of an existing HaxeFlixel rhythm game named Friday Night Funkin' that adds in a new character and became popular with millions of downloads from its novel visual effects and mechanics.

projects.title: Eternal Time Tracker
projects.desc: A mobile app for listing tasks and keeps track of when they will or had occurred.

projects.title: Riddem
projects.desc: A cross-platform Godot-based rhythm game made in 72 hours with features such as audio reactivity, visual effects, and my music.

projects.title: BadFlixel
projects.desc: A port of the famous Bad Apple video on HaxeFlixel using its builtin rendering features loading a customized binary format which was generated from OpenCV consisting of contour data.

projects.title: Squake
projects.desc: A HaxeFlixel game made in 3 hours (including its soundtrack) from the words: Square and Snake which is based on the appearance of the main player as a snake trying to avoid randomly spawning squares inside the digital grid.

projects.title: MangDownloader
projects.desc: An Electron-based manga scraper created for the purpose of being able to read manga without interruptions using HTML DOM manipulation.

projects.title: Jump Cubic
projects.desc: A 2 dimensional HTML5 game rendered entirely with code in javascript about a cube jumping on top of many incoming red walls which could last infinitely and gets harder.

projects.title: ESP8266 Wifi Midi Piezo Playback System
projects.desc: A project I made when learning about Arduinos which has a functional system for playing back MIDI files through a piezo module with its own serialized binary format.

projects.title: Youtube Archive Downloader
projects.desc: A CLI tool coded in Haxe that scrapes from the internet archive in order to track privated/deleted youtube videos.

projects.title: Realtime MIDI Harmonic Analyzer
projects.desc: A Node.JS tool that plays back a MIDI file through soundfonts and utilizes concepts of functional harmony in order to calculate dissonance rendered through a live web graph utilizing socket.io for client-server communication between the graph and analyzer.

projects.title: Math Game
projects.desc: A Math Game made in HTML/CSS/JS on December 2019.

projects.title: C++ Godot-based Flowchart Creator Tool
projects.desc: A work in progress Godot project that was made with the utilization of GDExtension in Godot 4 to render flowcharts with a customized look alongside extra features such as image exports and for optimization purposes.

projects.title: FNF Vs Robtop
projects.desc: A work in progress Godot port of the game Friday Night Funkin' with a team of artists and composers to create a FNF mod/fangame in order to put a novel twist on the trend of FNF mods.

projects.title: Web Calculator
projects.desc: A Calculator made in HTML/CSS/JS on December 2019.

projects.title: Six Nights at Freddy's
projects.desc: A command line-based game that I scripted in Batch when first learning how to code on 2017.
